title: Your charms have besties
caption:
Your charms have besties 🌱

Leave the room open and they chat, dance side by side, play tag and nap together. The ones that play a lot pair up.

Daily Charm is free to start on iPhone and Android. Search “Daily Charm” on the App Store or Google Play.
